senses.gloss:
प्र-√ यक्ष् P. Ā. -यक्षति, ˚ते (inf. -य॑क्षे), to hasten forward, press onward, be eager;
 (with acc.) to strive after, pursue, attain, RV.
प्र॑-˚यक्ष (प्र॑-), mfn. eager, strenuous (?), RV. i, 62, 6 (= पूज्य, Sāy.)

प्र-√ यज् P. Ā. -यजति, ˚ते (inf. -य॑जध्यै), to worship, sacrifice to (acc.), RV.;
to offer the Prayāja sacrifice (cf. below), TS.
प्र-˚य॑ज् f. an offering, oblation, AV.
प्र॑-˚यज्यु (प्र॑-), mfn. worshipful, adorable, RV. (= प्रकर्षेण पूज्य, Sāy.; others ‘pressing onwards, rushing on’).

प्रयाग m. ‘place of sacrifice’, N. of a celebrated place of pilgrimage (now called Allāhābād) at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā with the supposed subterranean Sarasvatī (also -क, AgP.; cf. त्रि-वेणी; ifc. also in Deva-pilgrimage, Rudra-pilgrimage, Karṇa p˚ and Nanda-pilgrimage), Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. RTL. 375; as N. of a country, Priy. i, 3/4; pl. the inhabitants of P˚, MBh.)
a sacrifice, L.
a horse, L. (cf. प्र-योग)
N. of Indra, L.
N. of a man (also -क), Rājat.
प्र-याग ˚याज. See प्र-√ यज्.
प्रयाग—कृत्य n. N. of ch. of the Tristhalī-setu (q.v.)
प्रयाग—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, SkandaP.
प्रयाग—दास m. N. of 2 men, Cat.
प्रयाग—प्रकरण n.
प्रयाग—प्रघट्टक m. or n. (?) N. of chs. of the Tristhalī-setu.
प्रयाग—भय m. ‘fearing sacrifice’, N. of Indra, L.
प्रयाग—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
प्रयाग—रत्न-क्रोड m. N. of wk.
प्रयाग—राजाष्टक n. N. of wk.
प्रयाग—वन n. N. of a forest, R.
प्रयाग—सेतु m. N. of wk.

प्रयाज॑ m. ‘pre-sacrifice’, preliminary offering (cf. अनु-याज, q.v.), N. of partic. texts or invocations, and of the Ājya libations at which they are employed (they form part of the Prāyaṇīya or introductory ceremony in a Soma sacrifice and are generally 5, but also 9 and 11 in number), RV.; TS.; VS.; Br.; GṛŚrS.
a principal ceremony or sacrifice, W.
प्रयाज—त्व n. the state or condition of a Prayāja, Kapiṣṭh.
प्रयाज॑—वत् (˚याज॑-), mfn. accompanied by a P˚, TS.
प्रयाजानुयाज॑ m. pl. preliminary offering and after-sacrifice, AitBr.
प्रयाजाहुति f. the offering of a P˚, ib.
प्रयाज्या f. (also pl.) the words spoken at the moment of offering the P˚, TBr., Sch.

प्र-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to be active or effective, TBr. (ep. also P. ˚ति);
to strive, endeavour, exert one's self, devote or apply one's self to (loc. dat. acc., अर्थे, अर्थम्, हेतोस्, or inf.), ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
प्र-˚यतन n. effort, endeavour (used to explain प्र-यत्न), Pat.
प्र-˚यतित n. (impers.) pains have been taken with (loc.), MBh.
प्र-˚यतितव्य n. (impers.) pains have to be taken with (loc.), R.; Bālar.; Car.
प्र-˚यत्त mfn. intent, eager, Bhartṛ.
प्र॑-यत mfn. outstretched, far-extended, RV.; AV.
placed upon (loc.), RV.
offered, presented, given, granted, bestowed, RV. &c. &c.

piously disposed, intent on devotion, well prepared for a solemn rite (with loc. or ifc.), ritually pure (also applied to a vessel and a place, Āpast.; R.), self-subdued, dutiful, careful, prudent, KaṭhUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
प्र॑-यत m. a holy or pious person, W.
प्र-˚यात mfn. set out, gone, advanced, MaitrUp.; R. &c.
arrived at, come to (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
gone or passed away, vanished, deceased, dead, Kathās.
प्राय—ता f.
प्र-˚यत्तव्य n. (impers.) = ˚यतितव्य, Nal.
प्र-˚यातव्य mfn. to be attacked or assailed, MBh.
प्र-˚यातव्य n. (impers.) one should set out, ib.; R.; Kathās.

प्र-˚यत्न m. persevering effort, continued exertion or endeavour, exertion bestowed on (loc. or comp.), activity, action, act, Mn.; MBh. &c. (instr. sg. and pl. abl. and -तस् ind. with special effort, zealously, diligently, carefully; ˚त्न ibc. and ˚त्नात् ind. also = hardly, scarcely)
great care, caution, Pañcat.
(in phil.) active efforts (of 3 kinds, viz. engaging in any act, prosecuting it, and completing it)
pl. volitions (one of the 17 qualities of the Vaiśeṣikas), IW. 68
(in gram.) effort in uttering, mode of articulation (also आस्य-प्रय्˚, distinguished into आभ्यन्तर-प्˚ and बाह्य-प्˚, internal and external effort), Prāt.; Pāṇ. i, 1, 9, Sch.
प्र-˚यत्ना f. N. of a partic. Śruti, Saṃgīt.
प्र-˚यत्न—तस् ind., with special effort, zealously, diligently, carefully
प्र-˚यत्नात् ind., also = hardly, scarcely
प्र-˚यत्न—च्छिद् mfn. frustrating a person's (gen.) efforts, Mudr.
प्र-˚यत्न—प्रेक्षणीय mfn. hardly visible, Śak.
प्र-˚यत्न—मुक्तासन mfn. rising with difficulty from a seat, Ragh.
प्र-˚यत्न—वत् mfn. assiduous, diligent, persevering, Kām.
प्र-˚य˚त्नानन्द m. N. of wk.
प्र-√ यभ् P. -यभति, futuere, TBr.
प्रायम् (अम्), ind. g. गोत्रादि.
प्र-यत—ता f. purity, holiness, MBh.
प्र-यत—त्व n. purity, holiness, MBh.
प्र॑-यत—दक्षिण (प्र॑य्˚), mfn. one who has made presents (to the priests at a sacrifice), a giver, donor, RV.
प्र-यत—परिग्रह-द्वितीय mfn. accompanied by a pious or chaste wife, MW.
प्र-यत—मानस mfn. pious-minded, devout, ascetic, MBh.
प्र-यत—वस्त्र mfn. clothed in clean garments, Hir.
प्र-य—˚ताञ्जलि mfn. closely joining the hands, Baudh.
प्र-य˚तात्मन् mfn. id. [cf. प्रयतमानस pious-minded, devout, ascetic], Mn.; R.
प्र-य˚तात्म-वत् mfn. id. [cf. प्रयतमानस pious-minded, devout, ascetic], Mn.; R.
प्र॑-˚यति (प्र॑-), f. offering, gift, donation, RV.
intention, will, effort, exertion, ib.; VS.
प्र-˚यन्तृ॑ mfn. one who offers or presents, a giver, bringer (with gen. or acc.), RV.
a guide, driver (गज-, of elephants), MBh.
प्र-˚यमण n. purification, Āpast.
प्र-˚याम m. dearth, scarcity (= नीवाक), L.
checking, restraining, W.
extension, length (in space or time), Jātakam.
progress, ib.
प्र-˚याम्य mfn. to be checked or controlled, ib.

1. प्र-√ यस् P. -य॑स्यति (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 71), to begin to bubble, AV.;
to endeavour, labour, strive after (dat.), Naiṣ.
2. प्र॑यस् n. (√ प्री) pleasure, enjoyment, delight, RV. (प्रा॑यसे, iv, 21, 7 = प्र॑यसे)
object of delight, pleasant food or drink, dainties, libations (प्र॑यांसि नदी॑नाम्, ‘refreshing waters’), ib.
प्र॑यस् mfn. valuable, precious (?), W.
प्रायश् in comp. for 1. प्रायस्.
1. प्रायस् ind. (for 2. See below) for the most part, mostly, commonly, as a general rule, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
in all probability, likely, perhaps, MBh.
abundantly, largely, W.
2. प्रा॑यस् n. (for 1. see above) = 2. प्र॑यस्, RV. iv, 21, 7.
प्र॑-˚यस्त (प्र॑-), mfn. bubbling over, RV.; AV.
striving, eager, Śak.
well cooked or prepared, L. (cf. 2. प्र॑यस्).
प्र-˚यास॑ m. exertion, effort, pains, trouble (ibc., with loc. or gen., -अर्थाय or -निमित्तेन), VS.; TS.; Kāv. &c. (cf. अ-प्रयासेन)
high degree, Jātakam.
प्र-यास See under प्र-√ यस्.
प्रा—यास॑ m. = प्र-य्˚, VS.
प्र-˚यास—भाज् mfn. capable of exertion, active, energetic, W.
प्र-˚यासित n. (fr. Caus.) effort, exertion, Mālatīm. (v.l. आ-यासित).
प्र॑यस्—वत् (प्र॑यस्-), mfn. having or bestowing pleasant food, offering libations, RV. (˚स्वन्तो ऽत्रयः N. of the authors of v, 20)
प्र॑यस्—वत् n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
1. प्रयो-ग॑ mfn. (Padap. प्र-यो॑ग) (for 2. See under. प्र-√ युज्) coming to a meal, RV. x, 7, 5 (Sāy. = प्र-योक्तव्य)
प्रयो-ग॑ m. N. of a Ṛṣi, TS.
(with भार्गव) author of RV. viii, 91; Anukr.
2. प्रयोग m. (for 1. See under 2. प्र॑यस्, col. 1) joining together, connection, Var.
position, addition (of a word), VPrāt.; Pāṇ. (loc. often = in the case of Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 4, 25; 26 &c.)
hurling, casting (of missiles), MBh.; R. &c.
offering, presenting, Hariv.
undertaking, beginning, commencement, ŚBr.; ŚrS.
a design, contrivance, device, plan, Mālav.; Rājat.
application, employment (esp. of drugs or magic; cf. IW. 402, 1), use, GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c. (एन, आत् and ˚ग-तस् ifc. = by means of)
practice, experiment (opp. to, ‘theory’), Mālav.
a means (only ऐस्, by use of means), MBh.; Suśr.
(in gram.) an applicable or usual form, Siddh.; Vop.
exhibition (of a dance), representation (of a drama), Mṛcch.; Kālid. (˚ग-तो-√ दृश्, to see actually represented See on the stage, Ratnāv.)
a piece to be represented, Kālid.; Prab.
utterance, pronunciation, recitation, delivery, ŚrS.; RPrāt.; Pāṇ., Sch.
a formula to be recited, sacred text, Śikṣ.
lending at interest or on usury, investment, Mn.; MBh.
principal, loan bearing interest, Gaut.
an example, L.
cause, motive, affair, object, W.
consequence, result, ib.
ceremonial form, course of proceeding, ib.
a horse (cf. प्र-याग), L.
प्रायो-ग॑ mfn. (prob.) = 1. प्रयो-ग॑, RV. x, 106, 2.
प्र-या॑ f. onset, RV.
प्राय॑ m. (fr. प्र + अय; √ 5. इ) going forth, starting (for a battle), RV. ii, 18, 8
course, race, AV. iv, 25, 2

departure from life, seeking death by fasting (as a religious or penitentiary act, or to enforce compliance with a demand; acc. with √ आस्, उप-√ आस्, उप-√ विश्, उप-√ इ, आ-√ स्था, सम्-आ-√ स्था, or √ कृ, to renounce life, sit down and fast to death; with Caus. of √ कृ, to force any one [acc.] to seek death through starvation), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

anything prominent, chief part, largest portion, plenty, majority, general rule (often ifc., with f(आ). = chiefly consisting of or destined for or furnished with, rich or abounding in, frequently practising or applying or using; near, like, resembling; mostly, well-nigh, almost, as it were; cf. आर्य-, जित-, ज्ञाति-, तृण-, दण्ड-, दुःख-, सिद्धि-प्र्˚ &c.; also -ता f.), ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a stage of life, age, L.
प्रा-√ या (प्र-आ-√ या) P. -याति, to come near, approach, RV.
प्र-या॑ण n. (Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29) setting out, starting, advancing, motion onwards, progress, journey, march, invasion, RV. &c. &c. (with गर्दभेन, ‘riding on an ass’, Pañcat.)
departure, death (cf. प्राण-प्रय्˚)
onset, beginning, commencement, Kāṭh.; ŚBr.
प्र-याण &c. See under प्र-√ या.
प्रा॑यण mfn. going forth, going, VS.
प्रा॑यण n. entrance, beginning, commencement, TS.; Br.; Up.
the course or path of life, MBh.; BhP.
going for protection, taking refuge, BhP.
departure from life, death, voluntary d˚ (˚णं-√ कृ, to court d˚), Mn. ix, 323
a kind of food prepared with milk, Pur.
प्र-याण—काल m. time of departure, death, Bhag.
प्र-याण—पटह m. a drum beaten while marching, Hcar.
प्र-याण—पुरी f. N. of a town (˚री-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.)
प्र-याण—पुरी-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
प्र-याण—भङ्ग m. the breaking or suspending of a journey, a halt, Pañcat.
प्र-याण—विचार m. N. of wk.
प्र-या˚णार्ह mfn. deserving death, W.
प्र-˚याणक n. a journey, march, Kāv.; Pañcat. &c. (cf. अ-प्रय्˚)
प्र-˚याणि See अ-प्रयाणि.
प्र-˚याणीय or प्र-˚यानीय, mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्रायणी॑य mfn. relating to the entrance or beginning, introductory, Br.; ĀśvŚr.
प्रायणी॑य m. (scil. याग or कर्म-विशेष or अतिरात्र) the introductory libation or the first day of a Soma sacrifice, Br.; ŚrS.
प्रायणी॑य n. = (m.), ib. (-त्व n., Kapiṣṭh.)
प्रायणी॑या (आ), f. (scil. इष्टी) an introductory sacrifice, ib. (-वत् ind., Vait.)
प्र-˚याणीय or प्र-˚यानीय, mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚यातृ m. one who goes or can go or fly, Kathās.
setting out on a march or journey, Var.
प्र-˚यात्रा f. See प्रायात्रिक.
प्र-˚यापण or प्र-˚यापन, n. (fr. Caus.), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚यापण or प्र-˚यापन, n. (fr. Caus.), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚यापणि See अ-प्रयापणि.
प्र-˚यापणीय or प्र-˚यापनीय, mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚यापणीय or प्र-˚यापनीय, mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚यापित mfn. driven or sent away, made to go or pass away, W.
प्र-˚यापिन् mfn. (du. ˚पिणौ or ˚पिनौ), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚याप्य mfn. to be caused to go, to be sent away, AitBr.
प्र-˚याप्यमाण or प्र-˚याप्यमान, mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र-˚याप्यमाण or प्र-˚याप्यमान, mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 30, Sch.
प्र॑-˚यामन् (प्र॑-), n. setting out, start, RV.
प्र-˚यायिन् mfn. (du. ˚येणौ, Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29) going forwards, marching, driving, riding, MBh.; R.
प्र-˚यावन् See वृष and सुप्र-यावन्.
प्र-˚यि॑यु mfn. (fr. Desid.) used for driving (as a horse), RV. (Nir. iv, 15).
प्र-√ याच् P. Ā. -याचति, ˚ते, to ask for, beg, solicit, request (with acc. of pers. and thing), MBh.; Hariv.; R.
प्र-˚याचक mfn. asking, requesting, imploring (with अर्थम् ifc.), MBh.
प्र-˚याचन n. asking, begging, imploring, ib.
प्र-√ 1. यु (only aor. Subj. -योषत्), to remove, keep away, RV. viii, 31, 17.

प्र-√ 2. यु P. -यौति, to stir, mingle, TS.; MaitrS.;
to disturb, destroy, Nir.
प्रा—यु See अ-प्रायु, ˚युस्.
प्रा-यु प्रा-युस्. See अ-प्र्˚.
1. प्र॑-˚युत (प्र॑-), mfn. absent in mind, inattentive, heedless, careless (cf. अ-प्रय्˚), RV.; VS.
प्र-˚यु॑त n. (also m., Siddh.) a million, VS.; &c. (cf. 2. अयु॑त).
2. प्र॑-˚युत (प्र॑-), mfn. mingled with (instr.), MānŚr.
confused (as a dream), MānGṛ.
destroyed, annihilated, MaitrS.
प्र॑-˚युत m. N. of a Deva-gandharva, MBh.
प्र॑-˚युति (प्र॑-), f. absence (with मनसः = thoughtlessness), RV.
प्र-˚युत्वन् See अ॑-प्रयुत्वन्.
प्र-˚योतृ॑ m. a remover, expeller, RV.
प्र-योतृ॑ See under प्र- √ 1. यु.
प्र-˚यु॑त् mfn. stirring, mingling, TBr.
प्र॑˚यु˚तेश्वर-तीर्थ n. N. of a place of pilgrimage, SkandaP.
प्र-˚युवन n. stirring, mingling, Hcat.
प्र-युवन See under प्र- √ 2. यु.

प्र-√ युछ् P. -युच्छति, to be absent;
 (with or scil. मनसा) to be absent in mind, be careless or heedless, RV.
प्र-यु॑ज् f. (prob.) a team, RV.
impulse, motive, VS.; AV.
acquisition, RV.
(˚युजां हवींषि or ˚युग्-घव्˚ N. of 12 oblations, one of which is offered each month, ŚBr.)
प्र-यु॑ज् mfn. joining, connected with (lit. or fig., as a cause, motive &c.), W.
प्र-युक्त mfn. yoked, harnessed, MBh.; R. &c.
stirred (by wind), Ragh.
directed, thrown, hurled, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
drawn (as a sword), BhP.
vented (as anger), MBh.
uttered, pronounced, recited, Up.; Śikṣ. &c.
urged, ordered, bidden, Gobh.; Bhag. &c.
used, employed, practised, performed, done, Br.; Kauś.; MBh. &c.
undertaken, begun, contrived, R.; Mālav.; Prab.
made, prepared, Kum.
(n. impers.) behaved or acted towards (loc. or acc. with प्रति), Śak.
lent (on interest), Yājñ.
suitable, appropriate, Pañcat. (see अ-प्रय्˚)
resulting from (comp.), ib.

प्र-युक्त—संस्कार mfn. to which polish has been applied, polished (as a gem), Ragh.
प्र॑-˚युक्ति (प्र॑-), f. impulse, motive, RV.
setting in motion, employment, TBr.; Śaṃk.; Rājat.
प्र-˚युग n. orig. form of प्रउग (q.v.), VPrāt.
प्र-˚योक्तव्य mfn. to be thrown or discharged, MBh.
to be used or employed, applicable, suitable, ib.; R. &c.
to be exhibited or represented, Mālav.
to be uttered or pronounced or recited, Śikṣ.; Śaṃk.
